flows.title: Breathe — Onboarding Intro
flows.description: Interactive breathing dot-field that opens the AI questionnaire. The red ball morphs through four health-need states — Weight, Muscle, Pregnancy, Gut — auto-progressing and tappable via the segmented control.

handoff.State input: ViewModel “Machine” · number “state”: 0 ball · 1 weight · 2 muscle · 3 pregnancy · 4 gut
handoff.Caption output: number “shown”: 0 hidden · 1–4 feature caption · 5 intro blurb
handoff.Layout: 402pt design width · animation stage 450×554pt, ball center at 39% of stage height · header pinned to safe-area top, actions pinned above home bar
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder)
handoff.Brand rule: Ball dots are red #FF3848 on #ED1C24; icons+headlines resolve to white. Never recolor.
handoff.Nav buttons: X + CTA = liquid-glass-js Containers (WebGL refraction of a page snapshot; X circle r22, CTA pill r27; tintOpacity 0.14, blur 5, rim 0.05, edge 0.01 — all tunable in the playground sidebar). Adaptive contrast flips content dark over light backdrops. Supersedes the earlier CSS backdrop-filter recipe. Native SwiftUI equivalent = .glassEffect().
handoff.Playground: Desktop (standard shell): sidebar with description, health-need state selector (drives ViewModel Machine.state, synced with the in-phone segmented control), and live Liquid Glass dials (blur, saturation, fill, rim, depth) + Copy values; device frame with Dynamic Island, fixed 874pt canvas. Mobile: original fullscreen adaptive layout with safe-area handling.

rn.note: The animation is a Rive state machine — rive-react-native plays the exact same .riv the web prototype uses. A Lottie export of the shapeshift loop is included as a fallback for contexts without Rive.
rn.code:
npx expo install rive-react-native
# fallback only:
npx expo install lottie-react-native

rn.note: One artboard, one state machine, one number input. Drive Machine.state from the segmented control; read Machine.shown to fade the captions. Never recolor: ball dots are #FF3848 on the #ED1C24 ground, icons resolve to white — brand law.
402pt design width — scale by width/402. Header pins to the safe-area top, actions pin above the home indicator.

X and CTA are the global Liquid Glass material — live recipe + RN mapping in the Glass Lab handoff (Design System tab). Type: Urbane Rounded Medium/DemiBold + Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder).

flows.title: Plan Builder — Intelligent Questionnaire
flows.description: Interactive UX wireframes for the diet-plan questionnaire. Opens on the Breathe intro (live Rive), then asks one question per screen. Three encapsulating directions — Feel lighter, Build up, Stay & thrive — followed by a health-context checklist (gut trouble, pregnancy, condition/medication) that attaches diagnostic modules to any goal: gut runs the 6-screen naturopath deep-dive into profile, foods, low-FODMAP journey, KD 19/39/69 tiers and consult; pregnancy adds a trimester screen and stacks safe adjustments (a weight-loss goal pauses its deficit); a condition attaches a consultation. Conditions are context, not competing goals.

handoff.Fidelity: Deliberate lo-fi wireframes after the intro — grayscale #FBFBFC ground, dashed image placeholders, brand red #ED1C24 reserved for selection and progress. Pattern first, skin later.
handoff.Flow map: Intro (Breathe, Rive) → Direction (3 goals) → Health check → [Trimester if pregnant] → Identity (skipped if pregnant) → Age → Body sliders → Activity → goal branch A+B → [Gut deep-dive ×6 if checked] → Food rules → Meals → Building → [Gut results: Profile → Foods → Journey] → Forecast → Plan & price picker → [Consult if flagged / condition / coaching] → Plan.
handoff.Branching: Direction picks the branch pair: Feel lighter = pace + cravings · Build up = training days + target · Stay & thrive = what-should-feel-better (multi) + obstacles (multi). Health context modules stack on ANY direction.
handoff.Question grammar: One decision per screen. Single-select auto-advances after 260ms (toggleable to a Continue button); multi-select always uses Continue, which reads 'Skip for now' at zero selections. Recommended options are pre-highlighted, never pre-selected.
handoff.Building screen: 3s of perceived intelligence — pulsing dot-ball (brand red, CSS) + four checklist lines that echo the user's actual answers, then auto-advances.
handoff.Plan preview: kcal/protein/carbs/fat computed from answers: sex + activity baseline, goal adjustment (pace −250/−420/−560 · muscle +120/+280/+450 · trimester +60/+340/+450/+330), protein = weight-slider kg × goal factor (1.6/1.9/1.1/1.2 g/kg). Meal names are sample content per goal.
handoff.Playground: Desktop (standard shell): screens jump grid, goal-branch override, health-context toggles (gut / pregnancy / condition), goal-screen experiment toggle (3 cards / XY dial), answer pattern (cards/list/chips), progress (bar/dots/count), advance behavior, corner-radius dial, UX-notes toggle, Copy values. Mobile: fullscreen + floating pill (pattern cycle, notes, restart).
handoff.Intro: Byte-identical Breathe recipe — same Rive artboard, glass X + CTA (global glass.json recipe), segmented control. CTA enters the quiz; goal selection syncs Machine.state so backing out keeps the blob in the matching state.
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder).
handoff.Gut intake: Naturopath-level, FODMAP-operational: symptoms (multi) → flare frequency (severity) → timing (upper vs lower gut) → trigger scan mapped to FODMAP families (onion/garlic→fructans, dairy→lactose, beans→GOS, apples/honey→fructose, sweeteners→polyols, fried/coffee→irritants) → stress (gut-brain axis) → red-flag safety gate (weight loss, blood, night pain, IBD/celiac history; 'none' is exclusive).
handoff.Gut profile: Symptom pattern scores 4 axes → named profile: Fermentation-sensitive · Reflux-prone · Slow-motility · Fast-motility · Mixed (IBS-like). Severity from flare frequency. Top-3 FODMAP suspects shown as confidence bars; 'not sure' falls back to the default elimination set. Explicit disclaimer: screening, never diagnosis; a dietitian reviews every gut plan.
handoff.Result explainer: Understand-first sequence: profile explainer (what's likely happening, in plain words) → foods in your favor (green list leads; amber list is 'for now, not forever', tied to suspect families) → 3-phase journey: Calm (wk 1–4 elimination) · Test (wk 5–10, one family back per week) · Free (wk 11+, personal list). Ops rule: all phases run on ONE low-FODMAP kitchen line + add-back sides.
handoff.Health context: The encapsulation move: gut and pregnancy stopped being goals and became a checklist every path screens for. 'My gut acts up' → full gut module. 'Pregnant or breastfeeding' → trimester screen, identity skip, kcal add-on (+60/+340/+450/+330), protein floor, pregnancy-safe meals, and a paused deficit on Feel lighter. 'A condition or medication' → consultation attached to the flow. 'None' is exclusive.
handoff.Forecast: The upsell picture: a 12-week SVG curve drawn from the user's own numbers — weight-loss rhythm (pace × weeks from the slider weight), gain expectation (lean +0.25 / bulk +0.45 / recomp +0.1 kg-wk), maintain = flat line with habit milestones, pregnancy = healthy-gain curve with deficit paused. Gut adds Calm/Test/Free phase bands. Milestone rows echo the chart (Week 4/8/12 values). Disclaimer: projection, re-drawn by weekly check-ins. One month visibly stops mid-curve — the chart sells month 3 before pricing speaks.
handoff.Plan & price: Duration (1/2/3 mo, −0/−10/−18%, 3-mo tagged Best value, each chip shows what it reaches: −2/−4/−6 kg or Calm/Tested/Free) × meals a day (2 meals KD 4.2/d · 3 meals KD 5.8/d · 3+snacks KD 7.2/d, default pre-picked from the rhythm answer) + coaching add-on (+KD 15/mo; locked-in free when red-flagged or a condition is checked). Price = perDay(+0.4 gut kitchen, +0.4 pregnancy-safe) × 26 days × discount. Live card shows KD/month, total, ~KD per meal, and savings vs month-to-month. Chosen plan + price echo on the final plan screen; consult booking follows when flagged, condition, or coaching.
handoff.XY dial experiment: Alternative goal screen (playground toggle '3 cards / XY dial'): a 2D pad — Y = calories (1300–3200 kcal), X = taste compromise (full flavor → all results). Dragging derives the direction live (bottom = Feel lighter with pace from depth: gentle/steady/ambitious · top = Build up with lean/bulk from height · middle band = Stay & thrive 'steady zone') and writes the SAME answers the cards write, so forecast and pricing just work — and it absorbs the pace/target screens entirely. Four live gauges give the big picture: Fuel (≈kcal/day), The scale (±kg per week), Your food (comfort-first → all business), Stick-with-it score (98 − calorie-extremity ×40 − compromise ×35, floor 25) colored green/amber/red.

rn.note: The whole questionnaire is one data-driven wizard: a steps array rebuilt whenever the goal answer changes. Branch questions and smart skips (identity screen removed on Pregnancy) come from the builder, not from navigation code.

The final screen must visibly derive from the answers — kcal and protein are computed, only meal content is sample. Keep the factors in one tokens file so nutrition can tune them without touching flow code.
Screen 0 is the Breathe flow unchanged (same .riv, same state machine). The CTA pushes the wizard; picking a goal writes Machine.state back so returning to the intro shows the matching blob.
The intake is data, the profile is a pure function of it. Red flags gate the flow (consult inserted for any tier) but never block the plan — advice softens, food stays safe.

flows.title: Rewards — Pull to Redeem
flows.description: Loyalty coupon redeem sheet with four Figma-exact member tiers. The perforation is punched holes: pull the stub and they pop one by one with an elastic recoil and a haptic tick (Android), each ejecting its punched-out disc, until the tab rips free with confetti and heals into the redeemed card with the promo code. Desktop opens the full playground; mobile is fullscreen.

handoff.Design source: Figma · Diet Station 4.0 · Rewards states (section 17137-76380; Gold frame 17137-75698)
handoff.Level themes: Sheet gradients — Bronze #D5BB9F→#C9A682 (to bottom) · Silver #E5E7EB→#D1D5DB (to bottom) · Gold #E4A70F→#FFBC2A (to top) · VIP #270F0F→#0F0E0D (to bottom)
handoff.Text colors: Gold/VIP: heading #F9F9F9, body white · Bronze: heading #0B0E12, secondary #5C3F21 · Silver: heading #0B0E12, secondary #7A7A7A
handoff.Badge pills: No visible ring (the Figma renders show the spec'd stroke blends into the fill): 24pt pill, per-tier 45/55 two-stop gradient, soft top bevel (inset 0 1.5 1 rgba(255,255,255,.35)) + the Figma drop-shadow stack. Text: Gold #C59300 · Bronze rgba(76,64,51,.42) · Silver rgba(82,82,91,.46) · VIP white.
handoff.Gesture: Pull stub right · travel = 96px·tanh(drag/90) elastic resistance · tears at 62px · below threshold springs back with overshoot wobble · haptic navigator.vibrate(25) where supported
handoff.Redeemed state: Tab rips free with white confetti; the card heals full-width (clip-path inset, .55s) into: 'Redeemed' + sub-line + dashed promo-code chip, with a white Checkout CTA on the right (white pill, #ED1C24 text, radius 60, 42pt, gel press). No check mark. The theme-tinted shadow resizes with the card (width transition — never clip-path, which crops outer box-shadows).
handoff.Layout: 402pt design width · sheet 806pt, top radius 38 · vouchers 368×125 radius 24 · stub 90pt · perforation 110pt dashed 8/8
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Light/Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder)
handoff.Nav buttons: Liquid Glass (iOS 26) close in CSS backdrop-filter; native SwiftUI equivalent = .glassEffect()
handoff.Coupon material: Exact Figma fill stack (component 17137-75573): per-theme tint (red rgba(237,28,36,.35), gold rgba(240,168,60,.35), others none) + rgba(173,173,173,.12) plus-lighter (Silver .06) blending with the SHEET, + on Red and VIP the voucher ambient shadow 0 0 12 rgba(56,64,74,.12). CRITICAL: the shadow must be an outer box-shadow on a transparent underlay — a CSS filter/drop-shadow on the coupon creates a stacking context that isolates the plus-lighter blend and washes the fills (this exact bug shipped twice). Optional frost dial 0-30px, default 0.
handoff.Viewport behavior: Desktop (>500px, fine pointer): sidebar + framed device. Mobile: fullscreen fit, sidebar hidden.
handoff.Rip mechanic: Punched-hole perforation with edge notches: two half-moon notches (r7) bitten into the top and bottom edges at the seam (x=243) — the real-coupon grip — with 7 punched holes (r3, y 18..107) evenly between, all true cutouts via one even-odd SVG alpha mask so each splits into half-moons as the tab moves. Tab peels around the topmost intact hole; holes pop top-down at staggered thresholds (30-100% of tear point): ring burst + ejected disc + card recoil + vibrate(8) each, [14,40,22] on the final rip; clip-path inset heals the card to the redeemed state. A released partial pull springs back and fully resets the coupon (holes re-arm). The grabbed tab reads slightly lighter (flat rgba(255,255,255,.15) overlay).
handoff.Playground: Desktop: sidebar playground (standard) — description, level selector, live modifiers (tear point 40-90px, stretch 60-140px, confetti 0-30, glass frost 0-0.4, blur 1-12) + Copy values; device frame with Dynamic Island. Mobile: fullscreen with floating level bar.
handoff.Nav glass: X button = liquid-glass-js Container (radius 20, tintOpacity 0.14, blur 5). Adaptive contrast: page-snapshot luminance behind the button > 0.5 flips icon/text dark (#0B0E12), else white — so Bronze/Silver themes get a dark X, Gold/VIP keep white.
handoff.Themes: Two themes x four tiers. Tiered: whole sheet takes the tier's Figma variant. Red (Figma 16842-87694): flat brand red #ED1C24 sheet, coupon tint rgba(237,28,36,.35) + rgba(173,173,173,.12) plus-lighter, voucher drop-shadow 0 0 12 rgba(56,64,74,.12), white text — only the loyalty badge pill reflects the tier. Toggle in the playground sidebar (desktop) or the Red chip (mobile).
handoff.Backdrop: Strip behind the sheet: #A6A6A6 on Gold and Red themes, #FFFFFF on Bronze/Silver/VIP (per the Figma frames).
handoff.Pull tab: Widened to 125pt (from Figma's 90pt) for comfortable thumb reach — Rashid 2026-09-03. Seam/perforation at x=243.
handoff.Type scale: Coupon headline reduced for breathing room next to the 125pt tab: big 26/34, mid 17/24, tail 16/24 (from 30/20/18).

rn.note: Everything in this flow is reproducible with four libraries. Skia is the load-bearing one — it gives you the real plus-lighter blend and even-odd hole punching that plain RN styles can't do.
rn.code:
npx expo install react-native-gesture-handler react-native-reanimated
npx expo install @shopify/react-native-skia expo-haptics expo-linear-gradient

rn.note: Figma-exact, from section 17137-76380 (tiers) and 16842-87694 (red theme). All sizes are pt on a 402pt design width — scale by width/402.

The coupon is two fills blended against the SHEET — a per-tier tint plus a gray plus-lighter layer (Skia BlendMode 'plus'). Draw the sheet gradient and the coupon in ONE canvas so the blend has the sheet to add against. The VIP/Red ambient shadow must be its own layer painted underneath — never a filter/mask on the coupon group, which isolates the blend and washes the fills (this exact bug shipped twice in the web prototype).

Elastic pull with staggered hole pops. Travel is tanh-damped; holes pop top-down between 30% and 100% of the tear point; the tab hinges around the topmost intact hole. A released half-pull springs back and re-arms every hole.
The web prototype could only vibrate on Android — on RN you get the real iOS haptics, which is the intended feel.

The close button is the global Liquid Glass material — implementation and the live recipe live in the Design System tab (Glass Lab handoff). Adaptive contrast: Bronze/Silver get a dark #0B0E12 icon, Gold/VIP/Red white. Fonts: DietStation uses Urbane Rounded + Proxima Nova (licensed, in this folder); the dot brand font ships from the Type Lab.
